comment: Published releases of invisible-playwright, one entry per version that actually reached the index. Back-filled 2026-07-27 from the artifacts the index serves, because this package had NO gate and NO ledger until then: invisible-playwright 0.4.4 went out built from a tree that predated the fix it was meant to carry, and a PyPI filename is never re-uploaded, so that artifact is wrong forever. Written only by `python -m invisible_core.release record`. Never hand-edited, and never shipped inside the package - a ledger that ships would invalidate the digest it certifies.
